headline: US proposes tariffs on 14 trade partners; Senator Blyth defects to One Nation; storm delays Macy's parade

austin.headline: Freeze warning covers Austin area on Thanksgiving morning
austin.summary: The National Weather Service warned of lows of 26 to 32 degrees from 3 to 9 a.m. Thursday across Travis, Williamson and Hays counties, and the city opened overnight cold-weather shelters.

texas.headline: Eckhardt and Huffines clash over comptroller transition
texas.summary: Comptroller-elect Sarah Eckhardt says incumbent Don Huffines has withheld transition documents and briefings and estimates 261 staff have been fired or left, which Huffines disputes, saying briefings are coming.

texas.headline: Cruz and Talarico jointly back Texas bid for U.S. Space Academy
texas.summary: The senator and senator-elect endorsed siting the NASA-led academy next to Johnson Space Center in Houston, competing with about two dozen states.

texas.headline: Railroad Commission investigates Atmos Energy over alleged violations
texas.summary: Regulators cited seven alleged violations from a routine inspection of the gas utility, which serves more than 2 million Texans, with possible fines up to $2 million; Atmos disputes parts of the findings.

texas.headline: Costly European trip helped end juvenile justice chief's tenure
texas.summary: Former TJJD director Shandra Carter, who resigned in October, logged about $34,000 in state-paid travel, including a roughly $9,000 European trip with hotels far above federal limits, the Tribune found.

texas.headline: State commission urges family and fatherhood measures for 2027
texas.summary: The Texas Commission on Marriage and Family recommended a governor's office for families, a fatherhood commission and mediation-first divorce, though a split Legislature makes passage uncertain.

us.headline: Administration proposes higher tariffs on China, EU and 12 others
us.summary: Using Section 301, the U.S. proposed an extra 20% tariff on Chinese goods and higher rates on the EU, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Brazil and others, which officials say won't take effect for a couple of months.

us.headline: Storm pushes Macy's Thanksgiving parade to Saturday
us.summary: Forecast gusts of 50 to 60 mph and heavy rain in New York led organizers to postpone the parade, as storms on both coasts disrupted holiday travel.

us.headline: Army calls Iowa explosives detonation successful
us.summary: The Army said its detonation of a lead azide stockpile in Iowa went as planned.

us.headline: Alaska ends voter data deal with Justice Department
us.summary: The state terminated its agreement to share its voter list with the DOJ, saying no voters were removed under it and ordering the confidential data destroyed.

us.headline: Judge finds FCC violated ABC's free speech rights
us.summary: A federal judge ruled the FCC violated ABC's First Amendment rights, NPR reports.

us.headline: Dec. 11 shutdown deadline looms as Congress debates funding
us.summary: Lawmakers face a Dec. 11 deadline to fund the government while still divided over spending priorities.

australia.headline: Liberal senator Leah Blyth defects to One Nation
australia.summary: The South Australian senator quit the Liberals on parliament's final sitting day of the year, citing spending, immigration and net zero, and Pauline Hanson said she will be SA's first One Nation senator.

australia.headline: Police probe emailed terror threat against NT ministers
australia.summary: An encrypted email to media and government offices threatened violence against Northern Territory ministers, officials and public areas over child protection policy; anti-terrorism units are assessing its credibility.

australia.headline: Labor takes dumped Liberal candidate to court before Victorian vote
australia.summary: Labor sought a Supreme Court injunction over Williamstown independent Paul Lindemann, dropped by the Liberals over racist posts but still listed under the party name, two days before Saturday's election.

australia.headline: Labor's year in parliament ends on a weaker note
australia.summary: The parliamentary year closed with inflation figures and a Senate defection overshadowing government wins earlier in the week.

ai.headline: U.S. curbs on remote China access hit Nvidia chip resellers
ai.summary: Sellers of Nvidia AI chips are reportedly seeking new buyers as the U.S. restricts Chinese remote access to AI computing, CNBC reports, citing sources.

ai.headline: Trump says a pardon for Jensen Huang is 'always an option'
ai.summary: The president said a pardon for Nvidia's reinstated CEO remained possible amid the investigation surrounding him.

ai.headline: Tech stocks fall again as Anthropic stays below IPO price
ai.summary: Nvidia led a second day of AI-driven selling, though stocks closed well off their lows and Anthropic struggled to climb back above its listing price.

ai.headline: Prediction markets push expected OpenAI IPO later into 2027
ai.summary: Betting markets now see an OpenAI listing coming later in 2027 than previously expected.

tech.headline: FCC approves SpaceX plan for 1 million data center satellites
tech.summary: The FCC cleared SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites for orbital data centers.

world.headline: EU leaders clash over budget and Ukraine loan at summit
world.summary: Leaders meeting in Brussels are split over a nearly €1.7 trillion seven-year budget and a €45 billion jointly financed Ukraine loan that several countries want to opt out of.

world.headline: NATO says its defence pledge covers space amid Russian satellite reports
world.summary: Secretary-General Mark Rutte said the alliance's commitment extends to space after reports that Russia could launch a nuclear-armed satellite within weeks, which Moscow denies.

world.headline: At least 30 killed in Cairo highway fire
world.summary: A fire on a highway in a Cairo district killed at least 30 people.

world.headline: Rescuers search for 13 miners trapped in flooded Indonesian mine
world.summary: Rescue teams are racing to reach 13 miners trapped in a flooded illegal gold mine in Indonesia.

world.headline: Wrongly deported Salvadoran arrives in Spain
world.summary: A Salvadoran man wrongly deported by the United States arrived in Spain after a legal battle in U.S. courts.

aus-cricket.headline: Australia regroup for T20I decider at the Gabba
aus-cricket.summary: With the series level at 1-1 after England's eight-wicket win on the Gold Coast, Australia's bowlers are seeking answers before Friday night's third match in Brisbane.

aus-cricket.headline: Chaudhary emerges as Australia's answer to left-arm spin
aus-cricket.summary: Nikhil Chaudhary has top-scored in both T20Is so far with 66 and 45, scoring quickly against spin that has troubled Australia's batters this year.

aus-cricket.headline: Bartlett has knee surgery, likely out of New Zealand Tests
aus-cricket.summary: Fast bowler Xavier Bartlett will miss up to six weeks after arthroscopic knee surgery and is targeting a Big Bash return with Brisbane Heat.

warriors.headline: Warriors beat Kings 129-110 in NBA Cup play
warriors.summary: Golden State moved to 10-8 with the win over Sacramento at Chase Center on Wednesday night.

warriors.headline: Warriors visit Portland Friday; Curry due for re-evaluation
warriors.summary: Golden State plays at the Trail Blazers on Friday, Nov. 27, while Stephen Curry, out six straight games with an abdominal injury, is listed for re-evaluation Friday.
